title: Look up and import a PNR
caption: Mirrors tools/e2e/specs/ota-admin/pnr-import.e2e.ts. Locally, an order of your office comes from the Amadeus stub or from a booking made on your storefront.

steps.title: Look up
steps.body: Type the record locator in lower case and press **Look up**.
steps.expect: The order: travellers as Amadeus writes them, flights, queuing office, net total; **Import as a booking**.

steps.title: Import
steps.body: Press **Import as a booking**, keep pricing "markup rules", add a reason, press **Import**.
steps.expect: The new booking opens: for an order without tickets Confirmed + ticketing manual review (with all its tickets: Ticketed + Issued), the record locator, payment not_applicable; `bookings.channel = 'import'`; `booking.import` staff action with the reason.

steps.title: Look up again
steps.expect: "Already a booking of this OTA" with a link.

steps.title: Another OTA's order
steps.body: A record locator of the demo OTA's office.
steps.expect: "This order belongs to an office outside this OTA" listing only your offices; no traveller shown; no booking; a `denied` `pnr.lookup` staff action.

steps.title: Advanced panel
steps.expect: The raw answer (net prices) with the call's facts; an `amadeus.getFlightOrderByReference` staff action.
